title: Français 3142 — Du Bellay, ff65–66
contents: Du Bellay complains to the Constable about efforts to remove him from Rome and a dispute over the bishopric of Bazas.
status: 4/4 pages transcribed; 1/4 pages deciphered; 3 more in part

excerpt: à ses freres et aux gens de Burgos **les raisons qui luy poisent sur le cueur il** les veult payer de bourdes **[?] devant eulx** pource **[?]**
translation: To his brothers and the people of Burgos, the reasons that weigh on his heart; he wishes to fob them off with tales [?] before them because [?].
